title: Second cohomology of a constant sheaf on an affine curve
statement:
Let $C$ be a smooth affine connected curve
over an algebraically closed field, and $\ell$ any prime.
Then $H^2(C,\mathbf F_\ell)=0$, with
etale cohomology.

proof.text: If $(\ell:k)\ne0$, a primitive root identifies the constant sheaf with $\mu_\ell$ by [def-sc-mu-trivialization]. Transporting cohomology across this isomorphism and applying [lem-sc-second-kummer-divisors] identifies $H^2(C,\mathbf F_\ell)$ with $\operatorname{Pic}(C)/\ell$, which is zero because [lem-sc-pic-affine] says multiplication by $\ell$ on $\operatorname{Pic}(C)$ is surjective.

source.place: Kummer sequence and affine curve case

proof.text: If $(\ell:k)=0$, then $k$ has characteristic $p=\ell>0$, and $C$, being affine, is separated; so $C$ is a smooth separated connected curve over the algebraically closed field $k$ of characteristic $\ell$, and [lem-sc-artin-schreier-dimension] (with $q=2>1$) gives $H^2(C,\mathbf F_\ell)=0$.
